officialLinks.label: University grading and GPA; repeated-course routing
CAS degree and major GPA context

helpIntro: NYU uses a 4.000 scale. Enter NYU credits and final grades to estimate your current or cumulative GPA and plan future grades.
helpNote: For standard NYU New York undergraduate GPA arithmetic. Repeat rules vary by school, so Repeat Impact is unavailable. External transfer grades are normally excluded; designated exchange work may need school-specific review.
helpExample: A 3-credit A- earns 11.001 quality points; a 3-credit B+ earns 9.999. Together, 21.000 ÷ 6 = 3.500.

gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.000; its quality credits count in GPA.
gradeExplanations.IF: Incomplete-Failing is excluded while recorded as IF.
gradeExplanations.IP: Incomplete-Passing is excluded while recorded as IP.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is temporary and excluded until replaced by a final grade.
gradeExplanations.W: Official withdrawal is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NI: Need Improvement is a midterm mark and excluded.
gradeExplanations.NR: No Record is excluded from GPA, though it can affect academic-progress review.
gradeExplanations.N: No Credit / Unofficial Withdrawal is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.R: Registered Auditor is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.UE: Unable to Evaluate is a midterm mark and excluded.
gradeExplanations.U: Unsatisfactory Progress is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.AUD: Auditor Status is excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: NYU course, standard University grading
specialTypes.note: Use the final NYU grade and NYU credits shown for the course.

specialTypes.name: External transfer credit
specialTypes.note: Grades from other post-secondary institutions normally do not enter the NYU GPA.

specialTypes.name: Designated exchange program
specialTypes.note: Some designated exchange grades are converted to the NYU scale and included; use the posted NYU record or school guidance.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is unavailable because NYU repeat rules differ by school. Check your school’s repeat policy.
